Blender is the free and open source 3D creation suite. 

It supports the entirety of the 3D pipeline—modeling, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing and motion tracking, even video editing and game creation.

info.description:
Videos about Latin American history, in English. *Vecinos* means neighbors; and if you'd rather have a friendly introduction than a wall, so to speak, then you're in the right place.

Most of us who are educated in the English-speaking world have  a blind spot when it comes to this region. I'm mostly here to geek out. But I hope the vids will interest anyone who likes history and is looking for exposure to something new. Teachers and students are especially welcome!

Follow on Mastodon: @VecinosHistory@mstdn.social
Bluesky: @vecinoshistory.mstdn.social.ap.brid.gy
or email vecinoshistory@proton
